column3: Fufufu～ Kyou-chan's sleeping face, how cute!
Why... are you in my room...?
Well, I came to wake you up!
Eh? Wait a second... Then that's just like...
Your mom said that you don't really get up in the morning. She was right... Teehee.
...M-Mother?!  Why did you have to tell something so weird to Manami?!
Mother, why did you have to do something so unnecessary!
Your mother's always concerned about you, right?
Rather than troublesome, it's kinda like...
Oh, that's right. Sorry for being so sudden.
If you want me to wake you up some other way, I'll do it next time!
...Well, that might be the case but..
Ah, if you don't like it, then I won't do it... Yes... Too bad...
There's a next time?! You're coming tomorrow as well?!
That's right. Your mother asked me to!
But... Maybe doing so is a bother?
Phew! All right then. In that case, I'll come wake you up every day from now on!
Eh... I'd like to be grateful, but... More importantly, that's the first time I've seen her so relieved.
So it's a bother, after all...
Ah, no!  There's no way it is!
